apiVersion.description: Serialized schema version. `agent-plugins.dev/v1alpha1` is the value every spec document uses; `agent-plugins/v1` is what the CLI currently emits and every catalog file carries. Both are accepted until the divergence is settled by ADR; `ap validate --strict` reports the legacy value.

providerId.description: Lowercase kebab-case, globally unique within the Catalog (catalog-spec.md:286-308).

packageId.description: Lowercase kebab-case, unique within its Provider (catalog-spec.md:310-338).

capabilityId.description: Dot-separated semantic namespace, provider- and target-independent (catalog-spec.md:340-361).

componentName.description: Upstream logical component name, not a filesystem path (catalog-spec.md:2015-2031).
